channel.title: Souvenance — lab log
channel.description: Release notes from an n=1 lab: Souvenance runs on the author's own life. Versions land here when they earn their place in a real memory. Nothing is ever pushed — you pull.

item.title: v0.3 — Reclaim your history
item.description: History import from official ChatGPT and Claude exports — day one, your memory already knows years of you. One-gesture daily log with an editable review step. Time capsules that resurface in conversation on a chosen future date, never as a notification. Founding interview conducted by the system itself. Yearbook generator. Ollama backend for fully local consolidation. Encrypted off-site backups.

item.title: v0.2 — The deep layer
item.description: Bi-temporal knowledge graph where contradicted facts are closed with validity intervals and never deleted. Voiceprint enrollment as an explicit act, plus speaker diarization where channel metadata beats the model. Timeline web app, mirror tool, persona compiler whose proposals only take effect once ratified in Git. Fidelity harness scoring recall accuracy per life domain.

item.title: v0.1 — The substrate
item.description: Append-only event log with UPDATE and DELETE disabled at the SQL level. Nightly consolidation, weekly REM recombination, active forgetting, reconsolidation. MCP server (recall, mirror, daily_log, curate, landmark, capsule) and the multimodal media pipeline. Executable constitution: exclusion perimeter, outbound actions rejected, full audit log.
